senses.en_definition: An English personal name, also used as a surname.

etymology.historical_story: Aubrey belongs to a European naming tradition rather than Malay word formation. Its familiar historical line runs through Old French Auberi or Aubri to Germanic Alberich, whose elements refer to an elf and rulership or power. That inherited name meaning is background information, not a description of the person who bears the name. [Name etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Aubrey).
